title: suderra.edge-provisioning.v1 device-bound provisioning manifest
description: Signed by the edge-provisioning key (ADR-048 DEC-3.1, DEC-5.5, DEC-5.6, DEC-22). It binds one device (device_binding, device_id, tenant_id, nonce) to one release statement, one trust-anchors bundle and one site config by statement digest; root verifies each of those as its own statement (statements.json). It travels in the delivery document of delivery.json and is kept only in /run/suderra-os until the install ends. The earlier flat manifest that Suderra-OS contracts.rs parsed under the same name was never produced and is removed (statements.json superseded_formats).

nonce.description: Echo of the nonce of the device's provisioning request (delivery.json); a fresh value per request (DEC-5.5).

key_epoch.description: Must equal the epoch of the key the DSSE keyid resolved to; it never selects a key (DEC-3.4).

release_statement.description: Statement digest of the suderra.edge-release.v1 envelope delivered with the manifest (delivery.json).

artifact_url.description: Download location of the release artifact on the network path; integrity comes from the release statement, never from this URL. A USB bundle carries the artifact beside the delivery document instead (delivery.json).

site_config.description: Statement digest and update_seq of the suderra.site-config.v1 statement delivered with the manifest (DEC-4.12, delivery.json).

trust_anchors.description: Statement digest and bundle_seq of the suderra.trust-anchors.v1 bundle delivered with the manifest (DEC-3.7, delivery.json).
